mapper.select: select l.account, r.id, r.name, r2.name as roleName, case r.profession when '0' then '学生' when '1' then '教职工' end as type from login l left join bms.reader r on r.id = l.reader_id left join bms.reader_role rr on r.id = rr.reader_id left join bms.role r2 on r2.id = rr.role_id where l.account = #{account} and l.password = #{password}
